ranking24.hits_definition: positive net matched SOL-sale P/L and at least one profitable sale OR positive net paper P/L and a paper TP; paper and real metrics kept separate
ranking24.ranking_basis: eligible hit, profitable sale count, realized SOL P/L, paper TP count, COMPLETE swap activity, latest activity; no speculative price-hit claim
ranking24.discovery_policy: Observed activity first, hourly rotating dormant remainder; discovery is not a proven winner
